data.name: Arfaajat
data.gender_notes: Arfaajat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arfaajat is a name derived from the Arabic word 'arfajat' which means 'waves' or 'currents'. It is a name that evokes images of the power and beauty of nature, particularly the water. The name Arfaajat carries the meaning “Wave, Current” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arfaajat usually hope their child will grow to embody wave, current and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arfaajat is a name that carries a spiritual meaning, representing the constant movement and change that is a part of life. It is a reminder that, like the waves of the sea, we too must adapt and flow with the currents of life.
data.etymology: Arfaajat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wave, Current.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arfaajat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
